description: Main source file for a Flutter-based personal notes application, handling app initialization, theme management, local database operations, and UI components for note CRUD operations.

classes.name: ThemeProvider
classes.description: Manages theme mode state and persistence across app sessions.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: Data model for individual notes, with serialization methods.

classes.name: NotesLocalDatabase
classes.description: Handles local SQLite database CRUD operations for notes.

classes.name: NotesProvider
classes.description: State management for list of notes, including loading, saving, and deleting.

classes.name: ThemeModeSwitcher
classes.description: UI widget allowing user to switch between system, light, and dark themes.

classes.name: NotesHomeScreen
classes.description: Main screen displaying list of notes with search and navigation controls.

classes.name: NotesSearchDelegate
classes.description: Provides search UI and filtering for notes within the app.

classes.name: NoteEditorScreen
classes.description: UI screen for creating or editing a note.

classes.name: NoteDetailsScreen
classes.description: Displays full details of a selected note with options to edit or delete.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point, initializes Flutter binding and runs the app.

methods.name: ThemeProvider._initTheme
methods.description: Loads theme mode preference from SharedPreferences.

methods.name: ThemeProvider.setTheme
methods.description: Sets and persists the selected theme mode.

methods.name: NotesLocalDatabase.getNotes
methods.description: Retrieves notes from SQLite database, optionally filtered by search query.

methods.name: NotesLocalDatabase.saveNote
methods.description: Inserts or updates a note in the database.

methods.name: NotesLocalDatabase.deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note by id from the database.

methods.name: NotesProvider.loadNotes
methods.description: Loads notes from database, filtered by search query.

methods.name: NotesProvider.saveNote
methods.description: Saves a note (create or update) and refreshes list.

methods.name: NotesProvider.deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note by id and refreshes list.

methods.name: NoteEditorScreen._saveNote
methods.description: Validates and saves the note, then navigates back.

methods.name: NoteDetailsScreen._edit
methods.description: Navigates to edit screen for current note.

methods.name: NoteDetailsScreen._delete
methods.description: Confirms and deletes the current note.
